nodes.label: Base App capability (base-app)
nodes.rationale: Minimum shell (launcher + profile); excludes admin UI; MUST NOT assume context selection.

nodes.label: Authenticated Shell Layout
nodes.rationale: Shell with primary nav + content region, reachable only via RequireAuth. Gastos-migration delta: shell home moved to /CxP/hub, index becomes a redirect.

nodes.label: Home Launcher
nodes.rationale: Default landing listing registry apps; empty registry renders gracefully. Gastos-migration delta: launcher lives at /CxP/hub.
